Vision Government Solutions

|

Foster,RI

|

Welcome

Welcome to Vision
Government Solution's Town of Foster, RI Database.

The State of Rhode Island requires that all
towns complete a statistical revaluation every three years with a full
inspection in the ninth year. The Town of Foster completed its full revaluation
in 2017, and has completed statistical revaluations with the effective dates of
December 31, 2020 and December 31, 2023.

Assessments of all properties are based on 100%
market value as of December 31, 2023. Due to real estate market trends
and variations in property style, appeal, and condition, not all property values
are impacted in the same way. Assessed
values in the database do not factor exemptions, tax credits, or tax freezes
that may be applicable.

Tax bills are mailed at
the beginning of July. A property owner may appeal their assessment to the Town
Assessor within ninety days from when the first quarter payment is due.
Directions for appeal may be found on the reverse side of the tax bill. The appeal form can be found on the Town of
Foster website: Townoffoster.com/tax-assessor

PLEASE NOTE: The values shown on this
website reflect the assessed values as of December 31, 2023, and the current
tax rate will be adjusted accordingly.

You may be prompted to install Silverlight (a free product from Microsoft) after you enter. Follow all the prompts to run the plug-in installer. In some cases, you may need to refresh or restart your browser. If you have any questions please call Vision customer support at 800-628-1013 x2.
